name: Aditya Mallapur
project: Built a smart weighing machine that measures both volumetric weight and normal dead weight.
memory: Filming behind-the-scenes footage while making a club reel.
self_roast: Sleep schedule is completely broken -- sets an alarm for 5:30am, wakes at 2:30am to watch YouTube, falls back asleep, actually wakes at 6:47am and counts that as a win.
peer_roast: Called 'the electrician of my life' by a friend -- basically the go-to guy for anything electrical.
peer_award: Nominated as most underrated member in the club.

name: Kartik
project: Built a gesture-following robot that moves forward, backward, left, and right based on hand gestures.
skill: Debugging, talking through project problems, and knowing what components are actually available in the lab.
memory: Last year's choreographed club dance -- shoutout to whoever choreographed it.
self_roast: Says it's a tough question to answer about himself.
origin_story: Heard about CorSIT and just joined.

name: Rishabh Singh
memory: Getting caught by the police once during a club activity.
self_roast: Jokes that he converts human feelings into digital data.
peer_roast: N/A -- roasted a friend (Shashank) instead, calling him the funny guy and a night owl.

name: Amogh V Hathwar
project: Line Follower Robot (LFR) -- a robot that follows a given line.
self_roast: Does the opposite of every instruction given.
hot_take: Every big friend group actually has lots of smaller friend groups inside it.
peer_roast: Roasted two members -- called one the 'Mandal' (a local nickname/group reference) and joked the other always has a hundred reasons for not showing up.
origin_story: Joined in 2nd year after friends convinced him.

name: Sumukh N
project: Deauth Detector using ESP32 -- scans wifi bandwidth and warns users about deauthentication signal attacks.
memory: ROBOCOR -- described as an emotional rollercoaster.
hot_take: Not a fan of people who dismiss hackathon ideas as 'already existing' -- believes execution can always improve on an idea.
origin_story: Joined to learn hardware -- says some stories are better left untold.
peer_roast: Roasted a friend (Siddesh), joking that he'll be soldering things in his dreams -- but he's genuinely good at it.

name: Siddesh M
memory: Roaming around with seniors and visiting Shredhara fast food together.
self_roast: Describes himself as complete in mind, but with incomplete work.
catchphrase: A casual Kannada phrase roughly meaning 'don't stress, relax.'
hot_take: Calls his time in the club 'the golden era.'
self_award: Jokingly nominates himself for keeping the lab clean.
peer_roast: Roasted a senior (Lochan) as the 'Idea Lab master brain.'

name: Lalitha Shree Sathyanarayanan
project: EduBot -- a friendly personal robot/assistant that helps monitor educational activities.
skill: Both casual chats and deep technical talks.
memory: Learning new things, club outings, and hackathon travel.
self_roast: Big ideas with last-minute tension and confusion, but somehow always pulls through with a good result -- even if the process behind it is messy.
hidden_fact: Actually really funny, just doesn't show that side to everyone.
hot_take: College is also about enjoying yourself -- bunking classes for hackathons, surviving on minimum attendance, and calling it 'career development.'
self_award: Always plans to go home early, ends up staying for everything anyway.
peer_roast: Roasted a friend (Siri Gowri) for asking a hundred questions about a project -- but every single one turns out to matter once you see the final result.
origin_story: Took the recruitment test almost as a dare after a friend said she wouldn't attempt it -- ended up genuinely loving CorSIT and getting selected, while the friend didn't. Says she manifested it.

name: Bindan S
project: Registering PUBG players on the last day (informal/fun task, not a technical project).
memory: A soccer competition where the ball mysteriously disappeared, only to turn up in someone's hand nearby.
peer_roast: Roasted a friend (Siddesh) as the 'husband of ChatGPT.' Also praised another member (Shiv) as the most punctual member of the club.
origin_story: Jokes that CorSIT basically kidnapped him into joining.

name: Prerana M B
project: Li-Fi based data transfer -- converts data into binary light pulses via a laser, sensed and decoded by an LDR.
skill: Keeping the team's energy up, plus coding and debugging.
tool: The club's broomstick -- jokes about how much sweeping she's done in the lab.
memory: Preparing for a workshop presentation with full confidence, then completely losing her voice on presentation day -- but pulling through anyway.
self_roast: Great at problem-solving, but also great at accidentally creating problems.
hot_take: Evenings spent in the club are often happier than an entire day of classes.
peer_roast: Roasted the club's own form creator (Dhruthi R S), joking she's impossible to roast in one line because of how well-connected she is.
peer_award: Nominated Dhruthi R S ('most likely to cry at an upcoming CorSIT event') and Srujan ('most likely to end up interning at Amazon or Google').

name: Sounak
skill: Jokes that he's 'only here for emotional support.'
memory: Preparing the track for the Rugged Race event.
self_roast: Says resource allocation in general is questionable.
hidden_fact: Jokes that he's given up on college.
hot_take: Coding is actually fun once you stop treating it like an exam or a career requirement.
self_award: Jokingly claims the '4th sem academic comeback award.'
origin_story: Says he got tricked into joining.
